title: Measuring, minimum girth, cutting height
rule: Trees must be measured before cutting or removal, must meet a minimum girth, and must be cut low.
points: Measure and record log volume for felled trees and standing volume for standing trees, or count bundles, head-loads or weight.
Minimum girth is in the Third Schedule. The Director sets it for species not listed.
Cut no higher than 15 cm above the ground, or just above a buttress or swelling.
